definitions.explanation: An artificial box placed outdoors to provide nesting space for birds.
A box used in beekeeping to house a bee colony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巣箱|すばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けた→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put up a birdhouse in the garden.

examples.japanese: {巣箱|すばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧シジュウカラ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A Japanese tit moved into the nest box.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巣箱|すばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a birdhouse together with the children.

examples.japanese: {巣箱|すばこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ハチミツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採取|さいしゅ}→採取：12901_saishu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Beekeepers take great care in managing their hive boxes.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧ (nest) + ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ (box). The birdhouse sense is more common in everyday conversation, while the beekeeping sense is used in specialized agricultural contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巣箱|すばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a nest box
- {巣箱|すばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける: to hang a birdhouse
- {巣箱|すばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a nest box
- {巣箱|すばこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧: nest box maintenance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鳥|とり}の{巣|す}→鳥の巣：24347_torinosu⟧: bird's nest — a natural nest built by birds themselves
- ⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧: nest — the general word for any animal nest
- {養蜂箱|ようほうばこ}: beehive box — a more specific term for beekeeping boxes
